title: Weekly operations review
description:
Thirty minutes, every Monday morning. The goal is to leave with **one** action, not ten.

Bring: last week's incident list, the backup report, and the dependency scan.

steps.title: Review last week's errors
steps.description: Sort by **impact, not count**. Note anything that repeated — repetition is the only signal that matters.

steps.title: Check uptime and latency
steps.description: Compare against last week, not against the target. Trends beat absolutes.

steps.title: Verify backups ran
steps.description: Restoring is the only proof. Check the date of the last *verified* restore, not the last backup.

steps.title: Scan dependencies
steps.description: Patch the high-severity ones this week. Everything else gets a date or dies.

steps.title: Pick one action
steps.description: One owner, one date. If nobody owns it, it is not an action — it is a wish.

steps.title: Post the notes
steps.description: Five lines maximum in `#ops`. If it needs more, it is a document, not a note.
